exposure: Mode of birth (Cesarean section vs. vaginal birth)
outcome: Chain of events leading to death
cohort: All 2,684,946 maternities in the Netherlands between January 1st, 1999, and December 31st, 2013, registered in the Dutch Perinatal Registry.
finding: Compared to vaginal birth, maternal mortality after cesarean section was three times higher following exclusion of deaths that had no association with surgery.
mod_finding: In approximately one in ten deaths after cesarean section, surgery did in fact initiate the chain of morbid events.
